observed_issues.issue: npm SDK build archive lacks tests/ts-core/gpu-dashboard-reference/main.zig, embedded by build.zig
observed_issues.resolution: Use the complete upstream v0.11.0 Git checkout, unchanged.

observed_issues.issue: Generated fixed-height virtual list mirror had unused Zig name/args errors when no numeric extent helper existed
observed_issues.resolution: Use the documented extent-estimate helper, returning a uniform 36-point row extent.

observed_issues.issue: Byte trim/split methods passed the frontend but were rejected by the external compiler
observed_issues.resolution: Use a small explicit byte splitter for the tab-delimited display pipe.

observed_issues.issue: Pinned compiler HTTP client source omits socketPath; a direct Unix-socket compile probe failed with SC3004.
observed_issues.resolution: Use the existing official Moby Go SDK in a small native worker for portable Docker transport.

observed_issues.issue: In-process native service compilation rejected child_process with SC4005 (async_free library requirement).
observed_issues.resolution: Use Native SDK's supported native child-service carrier; include its process in idle totals.

architecture: Native compiled TypeScript UI -> SDK-managed compiled TypeScript child service -> native Go/Moby worker; no Node runtime or npm payload.
renderer: SDK software canvas -> Cairo image -> GtkDrawingArea (GTK4 default presentation). Loaded GL/Vulkan libraries alone cannot establish selected GPU.
tests: No automated tests added or executed.
